rows.text: Sudarshan Agarwal, Returning Officer for the Presidential Election, declares at New Delhi on 16 July 1992, under section 11 of the Presidential and Vice-Presidential Elections Act, 1952 read with rule 35 of the 1974 Rules, that Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma of 6, Maulana Aazad Road, New Delhi has been duly elected to the office of the President of India.

locator.item: DECLARATION (English text), dated 'New Delhi, July 16, 1992', signed Sudarshan Agarwal, Returning Officer for the Presidential Election

rows.text: On 17 July 1992 the Ministry of Law, Justice and Company Affairs publishes the Returning Officer's declaration for general information under section 12 of the 1952 Act (S.O. 531(E), file No. 13(4)/92-Leg.II, K.L. Mohanpuria, Secretary).

locator.item: NOTIFICATION, New Delhi, the 17th July, 1992, S.O. 531(E)

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only.
